title: IntelLite
description: IntelLite is a SkyrimNet companion SKSE plugin. It comes with 5 actions - Fetch Person, Deliver Message, Meet Later, Assassinate and Cancel All - and the character-bio awareness submodule that lets an NPC know its own IntelLite meetings, contracts and messages. The four targeted actions can also be issued from the in-game panel. More info on github.
author: jykej
changelog: Improved the staged non-essential assassination path with a dedicated hold package, collision handling around the scene, and a retry/teleport recovery for refused attempts.
